summary: Open an existing playbook and ask the assistant, e.g. 'Analyze my web server playbook and tell me which Ansible collections are being used'; it identifies required collections, the modules used in tasks, and whether FQCNs are used.
questions: How can the AI assistant tell me which collections my playbook needs?
Analyze a playbook for FQCN usage with Copilot
Which modules does my playbook use?
